$comment: GENERATED FILE. Do not edit by hand. Source of truth: params.schema.json. Regenerate with: npm run codegen
title: SynthonosPatchEdit
description: A partial patch edit. Include ONLY the parameters that should change. Values outside the stated bounds are rejected, not clamped.

explanation.description: One sentence, in plain musician language, describing what changed and why. Example: 'Lowered the filter cutoff and slowed the attack for a darker, softer pad.'

suggested_name.description: A short evocative name for the edited patch.

osc1_waveform.description: Oscillator A / Waveform. Sine is purest, saw is buzziest and brightest, square is hollow. Related words: shape, tone character, buzzy, smooth, hollow.

osc1_octave.description: Oscillator A / Octave (oct). Higher is a higher register; negative values go toward bass and sub territory. Related words: register, low, high, sub, bass, deep.

osc1_semitone.description: Oscillator A / Semitone (st). Higher shifts pitch up in semitone steps. Related words: pitch offset, interval, transpose.

osc1_fine.description: Oscillator A / Fine (cents). Further from zero drifts the pitch and creates slow beating against other oscillators. Related words: detune, drift, beating.

osc1_level.description: Oscillator A / Level. Higher is louder. Related words: volume, loudness, presence, balance.

osc1_pan.description: Oscillator A / Pan. Negative is left, positive is right, zero is center. Related words: stereo position, left, right, placement.

osc1_unison_voices.description: Oscillator A / Unison (voices). More voices is thicker and bigger; 1 is a single plain voice. Related words: thickness, fatness, supersaw, stacked, big.

osc1_unison_detune.description: Oscillator A / Detune (cents). Higher spreads the unison voices further apart, sounding wider and lusher; too high sounds out of tune. Related words: spread, width, lushness, wobble, chorus.

osc2_waveform.description: Oscillator B / Waveform. Sine is purest, saw is buzziest and brightest, square is hollow. Related words: shape, tone character, buzzy, smooth, hollow.

osc2_octave.description: Oscillator B / Octave (oct). Higher is a higher register; negative values go toward bass and sub territory. Related words: register, low, high, sub, bass, deep.

osc2_semitone.description: Oscillator B / Semitone (st). Higher shifts pitch up in semitone steps; +7 is a fifth, +12 an octave. Related words: pitch offset, interval, transpose, fifth, octave up.

osc2_fine.description: Oscillator B / Fine (cents). Further from zero drifts the pitch and creates slow beating against oscillator A. Related words: detune, drift, beating.

osc2_level.description: Oscillator B / Level. Higher is louder; zero turns oscillator B off. Related words: volume, loudness, presence, balance, layer.

osc2_pan.description: Oscillator B / Pan. Negative is left, positive is right, zero is center. Related words: stereo position, left, right, placement.

osc2_unison_voices.description: Oscillator B / Unison (voices). More voices is thicker and bigger; 1 is a single plain voice. Related words: thickness, fatness, supersaw, stacked, big.

osc2_unison_detune.description: Oscillator B / Detune (cents). Higher spreads the unison voices further apart, sounding wider and lusher; too high sounds out of tune. Related words: spread, width, lushness, wobble, chorus.

filter_type.description: Filter / Type. Lowpass removes highs (darker), highpass removes lows (thinner), bandpass keeps only the middle (nasal, telephone-like). Related words: filter mode, dark, thin, nasal.

filter_cutoff.description: Filter / Cutoff (Hz). Higher is brighter and more open; lower is darker and more muffled. Related words: brightness, darkness, openness, muffled, tone, dull, crisp.

filter_resonance.description: Filter / Resonance. Higher emphasizes the cutoff frequency, from subtle sharpening to a squelchy acid whistle. Related words: peak, squelch, acid, whistle, emphasis, sharpness.

filter_env_amount.description: Filter / Env Amount. Further from zero makes the filter envelope sweep the cutoff more; positive opens then closes (plucky), negative closes then opens. Related words: filter movement, sweep, pluck, wah, bite.

filter_keytrack.description: Filter / Keytrack. Higher makes high notes open the filter more, keeping brightness consistent up the keyboard. Related words: key follow, even brightness across keys.

amp_attack.description: Amp Envelope / Attack (s). Higher fades the note in slowly (pads, swells); lower snaps instantly (plucks, keys, punch). Related words: softness, fade in, swell, punchy, immediate.

amp_decay.description: Amp Envelope / Decay (s). Lower falls to the sustain level faster, sounding more percussive and plucky. Related words: fall time, pluckiness, percussive.

amp_sustain.description: Amp Envelope / Sustain. Higher holds the note at a louder level while the key is down; zero makes every note die away like a pluck. Related words: held level, body, staccato, sustained.

amp_release.description: Amp Envelope / Release (s). Higher lets the note ring out after the key is released; lower cuts it off quickly. Related words: tail, ring out, abrupt, lingering.

fenv_attack.description: Filter Envelope / Attack (s). Higher makes the filter open gradually after the note starts. Related words: sweep in, opening speed.

fenv_decay.description: Filter Envelope / Decay (s). Lower makes the filter sweep close quickly, giving a short plucky bite. Related words: pluck length, bite length, wow.

fenv_sustain.description: Filter Envelope / Sustain. Higher keeps the filter more open while the key is held. Related words: held brightness.

fenv_release.description: Filter Envelope / Release (s). Higher lets the filter close slowly after the key is released. Related words: closing tail.

lfo_waveform.description: LFO / Waveform. Sine and triangle wobble smoothly, square chops on and off, sample and hold jumps randomly. Related words: wobble shape, smooth wobble, choppy, random.

lfo_rate.description: LFO / Rate (Hz). Higher wobbles faster; very low is a slow drift, very high is a nervous flutter. Related words: speed, wobble speed, slow drift, fast flutter, vibrato speed.

lfo_depth.description: LFO / Depth. Higher is more movement; zero is completely still. Related words: movement, wobble amount, intensity, vibrato amount, static.

lfo_target.description: LFO / Target. Cutoff gives wah and wobble, pitch gives vibrato, amp gives tremolo, pan sweeps side to side. Related words: what moves, wah, vibrato, tremolo, auto-pan.

master_volume.description: Master / Volume. Higher is louder overall. Related words: overall volume, output, quieter, louder.
